capabilities: Show Obsidian's default hidden dot-prefixed files and folders
Add custom show and hide rules for folders and files
Match paths by depth, glob, regex, extension, or exact path
Reorder and manage rules by priority in the settings page
Follow a specific file or folder when it is moved inside Obsidian
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a password or security tool; it only controls which files and folders appear in the file explorer.
extras: Desktop-only, since revealing hidden dotfiles requires desktop file-system access. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian always hides dot-prefixed files and gives users no way to selectively reveal or hide files and folders in the file explorer.
summary: Rule-based file explorer filter that shows or hides files and folders, including dot-prefixed hidden items like .git and .env.
